// diagnostic E0779

Jet.RepeatableKeyUnstable

The `#Repeatable(key: ...)` key on `{fn_name}` reaches `{effect_name}`, so retries would not produce the same key

What

The `#Repeatable(key: ...)` key on `{fn_name}` reaches `{effect_name}`, so retries would not produce the same key

Why

An idempotency key deduplicates retries only when every try computes the same key from the call's parameters and constants; randomness or clock time changes on each retry

Fix

Build `key:` from parameters and constants without calling `Rand` or `Time`

Worked example
